Activity Analysis & Visualizations¶

Daily Steps Trend¶

In [26]:
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

daily_steps = df.groupby("ActivityDate")["TotalSteps"].mean()

plt.plot(daily_steps.index, daily_steps.values)

plt.title("Average Daily Steps Trend")
plt.xlabel("Date")
plt.ylabel("Average Steps")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Average Steps by Day of Week¶

In [27]:
day_order = [
    "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday",
    "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"
]

steps_by_day = (
    df.groupby("DayOfWeek")["TotalSteps"]
    .mean()
    .reindex(day_order)
)

plt.bar(steps_by_day.index, steps_by_day.values)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Activity Level Classification¶

In [30]:
def classify_activity(steps):
    if steps < 5000:
        return "Sedentary"
    elif steps < 7500:
        return "Low Active"
    elif steps < 10000:
        return "Moderately Active"
    else:
        return "Highly Active"

df["ActivityLevel"] = df["TotalSteps"].apply(classify_activity)

df["ActivityLevel"].value_counts()

Sleep Categories¶

In [55]:
def classify_sleep(hours):
    if hours < 6:
        return "Less than 6 Hours"
    elif hours < 7:
        return "6–7 Hours"
    elif hours <= 9:
        return "7–9 Hours"
    else:
        return "More than 9 Hours"

sleep_day["SleepCategory"] = sleep_day["SleepHours"].apply(
    classify_sleep
)

day_order = [
    "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday",
    "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"
]

steps_by_day = (
    df.groupby("DayOfWeek")["TotalSteps"]
    .mean()
    .reindex(day_order)
)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))

plt.bar(steps_by_day.index, steps_by_day.values)

plt.title("Average Daily Steps by Day of Week")
plt.xlabel("Day")
plt.ylabel("Average Steps")

plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
